final: WITH district_counts AS (SELECT district_id, COUNT(*) AS account_count FROM account GROUP BY district_id), totals AS (SELECT SUM(account_count) AS total_accounts, COUNT(*) AS district_count FROM district_counts) SELECT dc.district_id, dc.account_count, 1.0 * dc.account_count / t.total_accounts AS share, 1.0 * dc.account_count / t.total_accounts - 1.0 / t.district_count AS difference FROM district_counts AS dc CROSS JOIN totals AS t ORDER BY difference DESC LIMIT 10
